description: Sector run: ethics, responsibility and society. Written as the COMPLEMENT of the generic run: labour, policy and China-facing publications it does not collect. Every URL was fetched and read as a feed on 2026-11-06, with items published within the previous ten days. Most of what these feeds publish has nothing to do with software work, so the pool is a floor to be filtered by the finder, and the prompt's jurisdiction searches are the real method. hackerNewsTerms is deliberately empty: measured on 2026-11-06, 'union AI contract', 'collective bargaining AI', 'works council AI', 'court AI layoff', 'fired replaced by AI' and 'AI layoffs lawsuit' each returned ZERO stories in 60 days at the collector's points>30 threshold, and the other terms tried returned only unrelated launches, apart from one story. Tried and left out: the ETUC feed, whose newest item was from 2024; UNI Global Union, whose newest item was from June 2026; and CWA, China Labour Bulletin and UTAW, for which no feed was found at the conventional paths. Those stay part of the prompt's manual method. windowDays matches the prompt's 45-day window.
